I am a student at the College of Idaho studying Mathematics/Physics with an interest in Statistics. 
Currently, I'm focusing on predictive machine learning. This summer, I will be conducting research related to predicting astronomical features related to Yellowballs using data from the Milky Way Project, and potentially using deep learning and other methods.
